description: Stop root execution of agent-writable sandbox code: run provision-python.sh through gosu sandbox, remove the /usr/local/bin/gateway symlink, and point the agro shell failure hint and quickstart at agro restart <name>. Local-only by operator decision (SECURITY.md): no issue, push, or PR.

userStories.title: Entrypoint runs control-plane scripts as the sandbox user
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the root entrypoint to run no agent-writable script as root so that an agent cannot gain root without sudo.
acceptanceCriteria: The root section of `.devcontainer/entrypoint.sh` creates and chowns the uv directories that `provision-python.sh` lines 35-48 create, before the provisioning call.
`.devcontainer/entrypoint.sh` starts `provision-python.sh` through `gosu sandbox`, in the same form as the `link-providers.sh` call.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/entrypoint.test.ts` asserts the `gosu sandbox` form of the provisioning call and asserts the absence of the `/usr/local/bin/gateway` symlink.
A new assertion fails against the current entrypoint before the fix, and passes after the fix.
If a tracked document under `.agro/skills` or `docs` tells the reader to run a bare `gateway` command, that document names `agro gateway` instead.
userStories.notes: Advisor re-verified on integrated task branch. (1) uv dirs: reasoned, repair_home_mount_ownership runs unconditionally at entrypoint.sh:327 before provisioning; worker added .local, .local/bin, .local/share to its install -d list instead of a duplicate block. (2) gosu form: reasoned, diff matches link-providers form. (3) no gateway symlink: executed grep -c usr/local/bin/gateway -> 0. (4) bare CONTROL_DIR grep: executed, no output, exit 1. (5) test assertions: reasoned, new describe block. (6) red-before-green: worker executed, 5 failed before fix. (7) bare gateway docs: reasoned, t3 sandbox-processes.md now names agro gateway status. (8) vitest entrypoint+provision-python: executed, exit 0, 68/68. (9) shellcheck 0.11.0 via npx: executed, exit 0.

userStories.title: Shell failure hint restarts the named sandbox
userStories.description: As a returning operator, I want the `agro shell` failure hint to restart my existing sandbox so that I do not create a second, empty sandbox.
acceptanceCriteria: The docker `shellFailure` hint in `.agro/cli/src/lib/runtimes/verbs.ts` reads ``container `<name>` not running? start it with `<bin> restart <name>` ``.
The test "prints the install hint" in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/lifecycle.test.ts` expects the new hint text.
The "Tear down" block of `docs/quickstart.md` shows `agro restart <name>` as the command that starts a stopped sandbox again.
The documents that pair `agro stop <name>` with `agro sandbox install docker --name <name>` to apply configuration stay unchanged.
userStories.notes: Advisor re-verified on integrated task branch. (1) hint text: reasoned, diff shows `${bin} restart ${name}`. (2) test expectation: reasoned, diff line 632; worker executed red run (1 failed). (3) quickstart Tear down: reasoned, diff. (4) config docs unchanged: executed git diff HEAD~1 --stat lists only 3 owned files. (5) vitest lifecycle.test.ts: executed, exit 0, 116/116. (6) pnpm typecheck: executed, exit 0.

userStories.title: Manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a command transcript of the changed behavior so that I can accept the change without a rebuild.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/sandbox-root-exec/evidence/manual-review.md` records the `grep` command of US-001 and its empty output.
The transcript records the hint that the built CLI prints for `agro shell <name>` against a stopped or absent container.
The transcript records the exit status of `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` on the integrated task branch.
The story creates no container, volume, or registry entry. If a check needs such a resource, the story stops and asks the operator.
